items.name: Anirudh😎
items.text: NSS IITP is like a family for me. It helped me to meet other students from different programs and levels (UG/PG) to work on issues of social importance. I was involved in projects related to education, health, and environment. It gives a lot of satisfaction when NSS team was able to contribute in these sectors. A holistic feeling where we enjoyed and was able to bring some change, living the tag line 'NOT ME BUT ME'.
